status: Closed — subcommand help ownership repair verified 2026-09-05
area: Subcommand help returns the whole command namespace
finding: atm <command> <subcommand> --help returns every option registered for the command, not the options the subcommand accepts. tasks import --help lists roughly ninety flags spanning claim, close, audit, scope, queue, roster and mirror, so the caller cannot tell which of them the subcommand will accept and must discover the right one by failing.
expectedBehavior: Help for a subcommand lists the flags that subcommand accepts. A flag belonging only to a sibling subcommand does not appear. This is the difference between help being a lookup and help being a haystack, and it is paid on every unfamiliar surface.
evidenceOrRepro: tasks import --task and tasks import --card each returned ATM_CLI_USAGE 'tasks import does not support option'. The correct flag is --from. Reaching it required tasks import --help, whose options array contains flags such as --ttl-seconds, --historical-batch and --sync-status that tasks import does not accept. The same shape reoccurs on evidence run, where the required --command is not distinguishable from the rest of the evidence namespace.
followUp: Resolved by ATM-GOV-0364 in commits f7a518c4469d291248b4c71f296a7c965bfbf4b0 and 91f599e471a1b48bbbf3f73e94e1ef13d013ae9d. Subcommand ownership was not recorded anywhere, so recording it was the fix: CommandOption gained an optional subcommands list, makeHelpResult narrows to the subcommand parsed from argv, and ten tasks options declare ownership as the first adopters — tasks import --help drops from 67 flags to 61 with --map, --wip-commit, --discard-wip, --reserved-ok, --all-stale and --apply gone. A flag that has not declared ownership is still listed rather than hidden, and the response reports declared versus undeclared counts so an unfiltered list reads as an incomplete spec rather than as an answer. Remaining work is data, not design: the other tasks options, and the other command specs, can declare ownership incrementally without further code change. Regression guard: test_atm_gov_0364_help_is_scoped_to_the_subcommand in tests/cli/governance-round-trip-cost.test.ts, which asserts against the real tasks spec that import is strictly narrower and that six named sibling-only flags are absent.
